:::{.justify}
The fourth Dutch Development Economics Network PhD Workshop will bring PhD researchers together at the Tinbergen Institute in Amsterdam on Friday 6 November 2026. The final programme includes seven paper presentations, each with an assigned discussant, and eight posters, alongside a networking activity and time to exchange ideas over coffee and lunch.

Research spans agricultural extension, health insurance, food security, menstrual norms, air pollution, electricity consumption, and schooling and crime. The day will close with dinner at Axum restaurant from 18:00 to 20:00, followed by drinks nearby at participants' own cost.
:::

### Programme

Friday 6 November 2026. All times are local to Amsterdam.

::: {.programme}
